title: Gene therapy costs remain prohibitive
summary: People describe current gene therapy pricing as prohibitive even when the treatment may be life-saving.
evidenceQuotes: The cost of current gene therapy products is prohibitive, and it is likely to get worse.

title: Families question how treatment can be affordable
summary: High treatment prices prompt patients and caregivers to question whether families can realistically access gene therapy.
evidenceQuotes: A treatment can save a child's life, but a multimillion-dollar price leaves families facing an impossible access question.

title: Access pathways shape patient outcomes
summary: Online discussion links cell and gene therapy access barriers directly to patient outcomes and the broader care journey.
evidenceQuotes: Addressing challenges on the path to cell and gene therapy treatment is crucial to improving access and outcomes.

title: Commercialization creates conflict concerns
summary: Some social discussion connects gene therapy commercialization with conflicts of interest, ownership, and insurance discrimination concerns.
evidenceQuotes: Commercialization and conflicts of interest raise questions about owning the genome and genetic discrimination.

title: Patients hold hope for a future cure
summary: Patients with serious conditions describe gene therapy as a source of hope for a future cure.
evidenceQuotes: I have always hoped for gene therapy for a cure for my MND. Maybe it is happening.

title: NHS adoption reinforces treatment trust
summary: Commissioning and health-system adoption are cited as evidence that gene therapy is making credible progress.
evidenceQuotes: It is the first NHS England commissioned gene therapy and it has made great progress.

title: Hope is tempered by equity and ethics concerns
summary: People acknowledge gene therapy's potential while weighing equity, insurance access, and the ethics of genetic intervention.
evidenceQuotes: I love how much gene therapy can help people, but I also consider equity, access, and complex ethical issues.

title: Genetic disease communities follow emerging research
summary: People living with genetic disease closely follow research that could eventually create a treatment option for them.
evidenceQuotes: I have a genetic eye disease that might one day be treated with gene therapy.

title: Experimental framing fuels distrust
summary: Some online discussion frames gene therapy as dangerous experimentation and questions the legitimacy of clinical evidence.
evidenceQuotes: The treatment is described as dangerous, ineffective, untested gene therapy.

title: Unknown side effects shape treatment refusal
summary: People cite unknown side effects, bodily autonomy, and institutional mistrust when rejecting gene therapy.
evidenceQuotes: I will never again submit to experimental gene therapy with unknown side effects.

title: Long-term harm concerns amplify mistrust
summary: Social posts connect fear of long-term harm with declining trust in government and the pharmaceutical industry.
evidenceQuotes: People question long-term damage after trusting government and the pharmaceutical industry.

title: Vaccine narratives are conflated with gene therapy
summary: Misinformation and vaccine-related discourse are repeatedly conflated with gene therapy, creating a distinct education and trust challenge.
evidenceQuotes: Online posts conflate vaccines with gene therapy and use the association to reinforce broader distrust.
